parent: The archived 8da4 executable with its exact weights. The two training arms start from its deployed, dequantized Sapling policy. The it50 partner, guard, mixture coefficients, decoder and all production code stay byte-identical.
data: Use only the predetermined 24 physical training maps, 64 roots per map. Validation and development each contain four disjoint physical maps, with 48 prechosen roots per map. No outcome, future position, private observer input or teacher search field enters the student's forward arguments. Unrepresentable prefixes exclude affected and later slots.
arms_fit: Freeze value/utility/margin/WDL/auxiliary heads. Both arms update every Sapling policy block and readout using the same fixed shuffled single pass. Immediate supervised CE uses the recorded full-original expert commands with the actual per-slot teacher prefix. Hold the release parent's free guard choice fixed within each fitting root. Existing it50 term contributes 75%, Sapling 25%, under the existing centering convention. Compute parent-to-new KL on the same legal menu. Use original native corpus half root-equal per role and half root-equal per actionable slot.
auxiliary: The joint arm also fits two training-only affine heads on the current worker's Sapling GRU state after its previous allied prefix and before its own action. Predict the observed 12-step toroidal net direction with five classes among surviving workers, and survival at 12 steps for each known worker. Actual labels are out of actor inputs. Omit base slots, padding, unrepresentable prefixes and windows extending past terminal. Average separately within each root across valid workers, then over roots in the batch (zero contribution for roots with none). Initialize the two auxiliary heads to zero. No auxiliary weights enter a deployment package.
optimization: Torch AdamW with defaults other than the stated learning rate and weight decay. Deterministic common minibatches generated by numpy.default_rng(seed). Before any update compare centered legal production and Torch logits across training geographies, max error < 0.003. Stop on nonfinite losses or gradients. Fixed last step only. Requantize raw archived Sapling plus update relative to its dequantized parent. Verify production executable bytes outside student payload and every frozen tensor, audit changes in encoder/GRU and both seats' actual commands.
held_assessment: After freezing all model hashes, report current-action hit and NLL for parent, bc and joint under true held expert prefixes using the actual exported quantization. Report direction and survival NLL/accuracy for the joint readout and training-frequency baselines, role and map counts, separately for validation and development. No checkpoint selection or retraining. Independently run the unmodified free-action package in a separate review, keep both positive and negative changes. None of these scores measure wins.
